Lots of Vietnamese locals
Mar 2025 • Family
This is a short 10 minute walk from the Victoria Resort. If you’re bored of Spices, then it’s worth a short trek to see where locals eat and celebrate. It’s a very large restaurant and many tables are reserved. There are large groups of Vietnamese locals eating and celebrating together. There are many dishes that are unique compared to Vietnamese restaurants in North America. Even the cha gio (spring rolls) were different from anything I have had previously. Expect the service and atmosphere to be consistent with Vietnamese norms. This is a great place to go if you want a slightly more upscale Vietnamese establishment, and want something different than places that cater to Western tourists.

A Hidden Gem with a View to Match
Oct 2024 • Business
If you’re looking for authentic southern Vietnamese cuisine, Lua Nep in Can Tho is a must-visit. My colleagues vouched for its authenticity, and the dishes did not disappoint. The menu is simple yet packed with flavors that truly capture the essence of the region.

The service was attentive and friendly, making the experience even more enjoyable. The view of the Mekong River is breathtaking, especially at sunset, adding a serene and picturesque backdrop to your meal. The vibe of the restaurant is warm and inviting, creating a relaxed atmosphere for dining.

A standout feature of Lua Nep is its bathroom arrangement—it feels like stepping into an art gallery. It’s such a unique and unexpected touch that added a layer of charm to the visit.

I would gladly return and recommend this restaurant to anyone visiting Can Tho. Lua Nep is a true hidden gem!

5/5 for Lunch by the banks of the Mekong
Dec 2024 • Friends
A local friend brought me here for lunch today. He spoke to the waiters in Vietnamese when we arrived and they led us to a fabulous table right by the banks of the Mekong.

Our service was spot on, and the mainly young staff genuinely made us feel welcome. 

I tried a brand new dish for the first time, burned rice in an absolutely delicious authentic fish sauce. For something so basic, it is seriously the yummiest food ever!

Rest of lunch by the Mekong included: Crispy grilled goby fish with salt and chili, grilled squid eggs, & good old grilled oysters.

Eating by the Mekong is wonderful, watching the river, I almost felt myself leave my body and drift away along the Mekong. It is such a lovely location for a restaurant.

Very good restaurant. Not a tourist trap.
Dec 2023 • Family
As our driver was driving up the beautiful long driveway of the restaurant, I thought “this place looks like a tropical resort that you would see in Hawaii, not a restaurant near the Mekong River. It has to be a tourist trap.” I was very skeptical about dining here with my husband, 3 kids, and my parents. As it turns out, my intuition was completely wrong. We ordered twelve dishes (beef, calamari, eel, frog legs, Vietnamese pancakes, soup, and stir fried veggies). Service was quick, place was clean, and every dish was delicious. There is even an indoor playground with swings and see-saw. The only negative was the beef dish was a small portion, so we ordered it again. Highly recommended this restaurant for families. It was a 10 min drive from our hotel (Ninh Kieu Riverside Hotel).
